mapper.sql: api_interface.id, api_interface.english_name, api_interface.chinese_name, api_interface.url_slug, api_interface.method, api_interface.data_source_id, ds.name AS data_source_name, api_interface.query_type, api_interface.query_content, api_interface.is_paginated, api_interface.page_size, api_interface.status, api_interface.created_by, api_interface.created_at, api_interface.last_modified_by, api_interface.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_interface (english_name, chinese_name, url_slug, method, data_source_id, query_type, query_content, is_paginated, page_size, status, created_by, created_at, last_modified_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{englishName}, #{chineseName}, #{urlSlug}, #{method}, #{dataSourceId}, #{queryType}, #{queryContent}, #{isPaginated}, #{pageSize}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{lastModifiedBy}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM api_interface LEFT JOIN data_source ds ON ds.id = api_interface.data_source_id WHERE api_interface.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM api_interface LEFT JOIN data_source ds ON ds.id = api_interface.data_source_id WHERE api_interface.data_source_id = #{dataSourceId} ORDER BY api_interface.created_at DESC
